Blessings.name: Adrenaline Junkie
Blessings.tagline: Increase your maximum adrenaline and adrenaline generation by 50%.
effects: Your maximum adrenaline is increased by 50%.
Adrenaline generation is increased by 50%.

Blessings.name: Big Boned
Blessings.tagline: Increase your maximum life points and do more damage based on your max health.
effects: Your maximum life points are increased by 50%.
All damage you deal gains 5% of your maximum life points as bonus damage.

Blessings.name: Teragard's Aegis
Blessings.tagline: Converts your armour into ability damage and health regeneration, with greater bonuses from defenders and shields.
effects: Your base ability damage is increased by 25% of your total armour value. This bonus is doubled while wielding a defender and tripled while wielding a shield.
Your base health regeneration is increased by 25% of your maximum life points. This bonus is doubled while wielding a defender and tripled while wielding a shield.

Blessings.name: Abyssal Cinders
Blessings.tagline: Adds bonus damage to your abilities and a chance to trigger bonus damage.
effects: On hit: Your attacks deal 15% of ability damage as bonus damage.
On hit: Your attacks have a 5% chance to Trigger an Inferno of Zamorak.
Inferno of Zamorak: Deals 100-200% ability damage to a single target.

Blessings.name: Barkscales
Blessings.tagline: Reduces incoming damage based on your armour and has a chance to apply an area-of-effect poison.
effects: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of your armour value.
After Barkscales reduces damage 5 times, unleash a Grasp of Guthix at your attacker's location.
Grasp of Guthix: Deals poison damage equal to 80-120% of your ability damage in a 3x3 area.

Blessings.name: Striking Light
Blessings.tagline: Strengthens your basic attacks and adds a recurring ability that scales with your armour.
effects: Your basic attack's damage is increased by 40%.
Your basic attacks unleash a Light of Saradomin on your target. 9s cooldown.
Light of Saradomin: Deals damage equal to 40-60% of your ability damage, plus 250% of your armour value.

Blessings.name: Avernic Rampage
Blessings.tagline: A chance to make abilities and special attacks cost no adrenaline.
effects: On-attack: 5% chance to activate Avernic Rampage for 7.2s.
Avernic Rampage: Abilities and special attacks cost 0% adrenaline.

Blessings.name: Eternal Sustenance
Blessings.tagline: Eat food without consuming it or losing adrenaline.
effects: Food is no longer consumed when eaten.
You no longer lose adrenaline when eating.

Blessings.name: Steadfast Will
Blessings.tagline: Greatly empowers Bash, Preparation, Reflect, and Revenge.
effects: Empowers the 'Bash', 'Preparation', 'Reflect', and 'Revenge' abilities.
Bash: Deals additional damage equal to 350-450% of your armour value.
Preparation: On activation reduces the cooldown of all abilities by 12s.
Reflect: Reflects 100% of incoming damage + 10-15% of your armour value as additional damage. Reflected damage hits up to 8 additional targets within 3 tiles of you.
Revenge: The duration and cooldown of this ability is doubled. The maximum number of stacks is increased by 20.

Blessings.name: Demon's Mark
Blessings.tagline: Your accuracy is calculated using your target's weakness
effects: Your accuracy is always calculated using your target's weakness.

Blessings.name: Splash Zone
Blessings.tagline: Deal bonus damage with AOE abilities depending on the targets size.
effects: Area of effect and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
Area of effect abilities deal 5% more damage per tile the target occupies.

Blessings.name: Sacred Fervor
Blessings.tagline: Reduces all combat ability and special attack cooldowns by 30%.
effects: Melee ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Magic ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Ranged ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Necromancy ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.

Blessings.name: Havoc Born
Blessings.tagline: Deal more damage at the cost of maximum life points and armour.
effects: Your damage is increased by 20%.
Your maximum life points are reduced by 25%.
Your armour value is reduced by 25%.

Blessings.name: True Equilibrium
Blessings.tagline: Gain combat stats for each relic alignment you have chosen.
effects: Gain 75 base ability damage for each relic alignment you have chosen.
Gain 50 armour for each relic alignment you have chosen.
Gain 500 life points for each relic alignment you have chosen.
Gain 5% critical strike chance for each relic alignment you have chosen.
Gain 7.5% critical strike damage for each relic alignment you have chosen.
Gain 5 prayer bonus for each relic alignment you have chosen.

Blessings.name: Higher Power
Blessings.tagline: Increase base ability damage in exchange for combat ultimates.
effects: Your base ability damage is increased by 30%.
You lose access to the Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine abilities.

Blessings.name: Unholy Critual
Blessings.tagline: Convert excess critical strike chance into damage and unleash empowered Infernos of Zamorak.
effects: Gain +15% critical strike chance.
Your critical strike chance is capped at 50%.
All excess critical strike chance is converted into critical strike damage at a 1:1 ratio.
Inferno of Zamorak gains +50% critical strike damage.
On critical strike: Unleash an Inferno of Zamorak.
Inferno of Zamorak: Deals 100-200% ability damage to a single target.

Blessings.name: Tearing Thorns
Blessings.tagline: Extend damage-over-time abilities and trigger stronger Grasps of Guthix.
effects: Damage-over-time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit of a damage-over-time ability triggers a Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp of Guthix deals additional damage equal to 20-30% of your maximum life points.
Grasp of Guthix: Deals poison damage equal to 80-120% of your ability damage in a 3x3 area.

Blessings.name: Lord of Light
Blessings.tagline: Basic attacks unleash multiple healing Lights of Saradomin that scale with prayer bonus.
effects: Your basic attacks trigger 5 Lights of Saradomin at random tiles near your target, each damaging up to 8 targets within 1 tile. 14.4s cooldown.
Lights of Saradomin deal 2% increased damage for each point of prayer bonus you have.
Light of Saradomin now heals you for 5% of damage dealt.
Light of Saradomin: Deals damage equal to 40-60% of your ability damage, plus 250% of your armour value.

Blessings.name: Perfidious
Blessings.tagline: Empower Inferno of Zamorak, Grasp of Guthix, and Light of Saradomin.
effects: Empowers Inferno of Zamorak, Grasp of Guthix, and Light of Saradomin.
Inferno of Zamorak activation chance is increased by 5x.
Grasp of Guthix activation requirement is reduced to 2.
Light of Saradomin's cooldown is reduced to 4.8s.

Blessings.name: Envenomed
Blessings.tagline: Greatly strengthen poison and temporarily remove enemy poison immunity.
effects: Poison damage is increased by 50%, plus an additional 2% per Herblore level.
Damaging an enemy disables their poison immunity for 30s.

Blessings.name: Tempered Heart
Blessings.tagline: Continuously generate adrenaline.
effects: Generate 6% adrenaline every 1.2s.

Blessings.name: Chaotic Insight
Blessings.tagline: Equipped combat items count as additional pieces towards their set effects.
effects: Each combat equipment item counts as 2 additional pieces towards its set effect.

Blessings.name: Power Archive
Blessings.tagline: Store augmented-equipment gizmos and double eligible combat perk ranks.
effects: Grants the Automaton Control Bot.
Stores up to 20 weapon or armour gizmos, granting their effects while wearing augmented equipment.
Combat perks in stored gizmos have their rank doubled, excluding perks that do not benefit from additional ranks.

Blessings.name: Genesis Essence
Blessings.tagline: Treat your equipped weapons as tier 120.
effects: Your equipped weapons are treated as tier 120.
